title: Init flow: solo vs team docs question
description: bober init asks one question — commit sprint docs into the repo (solo, default) or keep the repo clean (team) — and writes documenter.docsMode into the generated bober.config.json. Non-interactive init paths default to 'committed' without prompting. Should-have: the feature is complete without it; skip if init internals make this disproportionate.

successCriteria.description: Interactive bober init offers a solo/team choice (prompts lib, matching existing init questions' style) and writes documenter.docsMode 'committed' (solo) or 'local' (team) into the generated bober.config.json.
Non-interactive init (existing flags / CI / --yes-style paths) does not prompt and produces docsMode 'committed' (or omits the key entirely, which resolves to 'committed').
npm run typecheck, lint, build and the full test suite pass.

generatorNotes: Entry point: src/cli/commands/init.ts (large file — find where other config questions are asked and where the config object is assembled/serialized; also check src/discovery/config-generator.ts, which generates configs from scanning, and keep the two paths consistent). The repo uses the 'prompts' package. Follow the existing question wording style. If init has a config-generator golden-snapshot test (see commit 255f992 'match golden snapshot'), update it deliberately and mention it in completion notes. Keep the diff minimal — one question, one key.
evaluatorNotes: sc-3-1: unit test drives the prompt with injected answers (prompts supports injection via prompts.inject) or tests the pure config-assembly function for both answers. sc-3-2: run/simulate the non-interactive path; assert no new prompt fires and the generated config resolves to docsMode 'committed'. sc-3-3: full suite + typecheck + lint + build. Verify the generated config still passes BoberConfigSchema.parse.
nonGoals: Do not add more than one init question — a single solo/team choice writing documenter.docsMode.
Do not change the discovery scanner's stack detection or any unrelated init output.
Do not make 'external' an init option — external mode stays a hand-edited config choice (keeps the prompt binary and simple).
stopConditions: Interactive init writes docsMode 'committed' (solo) or 'local' (team) based on the answer; non-interactive paths never prompt and resolve to 'committed'.
Generated config passes BoberConfigSchema.parse; golden-snapshot tests (if any) updated deliberately.
typecheck, lint, build, and full suite pass.
definitionOfDone: bober init asks one solo-vs-team question and writes documenter.docsMode into the generated bober.config.json ('committed' for solo, 'local' for team); non-interactive/CI init paths default to 'committed' without prompting; the generated config validates against the zod schema and the suite is green.
assumptions: The 'prompts' package with prompts.inject is the existing test pattern for interactive init flows.
If this proves disproportionate inside init.ts, the sprint may be descoped by the orchestrator (should-have feature).
outOfScope: Any documenter runtime or md-surface change (sprints 1-2).
